split_strategy: Manual. The dominant failure mode is consumer-personal asks (divorce, PI, criminal defense, estate planning) that share the strong 'lawyer/attorney' pattern with B2B procurement positives. Three of the four consumer-trap negatives are in train (N1 divorce, N2 PI, N6 criminal) for iteration signal; one (N10 estate planning) is held out for generalization. Indirect-intent positives (P7 'outside counsel' for compliance, P10 'cap table review') are also in train.
passing_rule: should_trigger=true → trigger_rate > 0.5 over 3 runs. should_trigger=false → trigger_rate ≤ 0.5.
